errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

variantBlock.heading: Serialis refs
variantBlock.notTracked: This variant is not tracked by Serialis yet.
variantBlock.trackEffect: No write to Shopify stock. Existing stock is registered ref by ref (“already counted”); open orders are not changed.
variantBlock.untrackEffect: Units in stock become untracked with no write: Shopify stock does not change and the variant stays sellable. Not possible while units are allocated, in transit or awaiting a return.
variantBlock.initializingBody: Enter existing stock as “already counted” (no stock write). The gap with Shopify shrinks as you register refs.
variantBlock.truncated: Only the first {{count}} refs are loaded: the figures below are partial. Open the Serialis app for the full list.
variantBlock.noStock: No stock and no refs yet.
variantBlock.refsEmpty: No refs registered for this variant.
variantBlock.kindAlreadyCounted: Already counted in Shopify (no stock write)
variantBlock.addRefsHelp: One ref per line; spaces, commas and semicolons are also accepted.
variantBlock.previewSummary: {{ready}} ready, {{duplicate}} duplicate(s) in the list, {{known}} already known, {{invalid}} invalid format.
variantBlock.addNoGap: No gap in Shopify: use “Received” to add stock.
variantBlock.addTooMany: 1,000 refs at most per add: split the list.
variantBlock.addExceedsGap: You are adding {{count}} “already counted” refs for a gap of {{gap}}: the server will refuse those beyond the gap.

effectReceived.one: {{count}} unit will be created at “{{location}}” and Shopify stock will increase by {{count}}.
effectReceived.other: {{count}} units will be created at “{{location}}” and Shopify stock will increase by {{count}}.

effectCounted.one: {{count}} unit will be created at “{{location}}” with no write to Shopify stock (already counted).
effectCounted.other: {{count}} units will be created at “{{location}}” with no write to Shopify stock (already counted).

outcomeRejected.other: {{count}} refs rejected, left in the field for correction:
